reopening_bar.rationale: Deliberately asymmetric. Retiring took p=0.024 on a narrow sample; coming back should cost more than leaving did.

state_at_registration.caveat: Only the 30m horizon clears p<0.05 under clustering. At 5m and 15m the result is NOT significant. The retirement rests on one horizon of a concentrated sample.

auditing_standard: Every excursion run now reports asset-concentration HHI, coins measured, top-coin share, and a cluster-bootstrapped p-value. Event-level bootstraps are invalid here because forward windows on the same coin overlap.
